cd /workspace/cdk_app && for stack in ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1 ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-1 ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-2; do echo "=== $stack ===" npx cdk synth "$stack" --json 2>/dev/null | jq '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::VPC" or .value.Type == "AWS::EC2::Instance") | {key, type: .value.Type, vpcId: .value.Properties.VpcId, subnetId: .value.Properties.SubnetId}' done

cd /workspace/cdk_app && for stack in ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1 ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-1 ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-2; do echo "=== $stack ===" npx cdk synth "$stack" --json 2>/dev/null | jq '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::Subnet") | {key, type: .value.Type, vpcRef: .value.Properties.VpcId}' done

cd /workspace/cdk_app && for stack in ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1 ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-1 ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-2; do region=$(echo $stack | sed 's/.*-//') echo "=== $stack (Region: $region) ===" aws cloudformation describe-stack-resources --stack-name "$stack" --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq '.StackResources[] | select(.ResourceType == "AWS::EC2::Instance" or .ResourceType == "AWS::EC2::VPC") | {logicalId: .LogicalResourceId, physicalId: .PhysicalResourceId, type: .ResourceType}' done

cd /workspace/cdk_app && npx cdk ls 2>/dev/null | grep EC2 | while read stack; do region=$(echo "$stack" | grep -oE '(us-east-1|us-west-1|us-west-2|eu-west-1|ap-southeast-1)$') echo "=== $stack (Region: $region) ===" aws cloudformation describe-stack-resources --stack-name "$stack" --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq '.StackResources[] | select(.ResourceType == "AWS::EC2::Instance" or .ResourceType == "AWS::EC2::VPC") | {logicalId: .LogicalResourceId, physicalId: .PhysicalResourceId, type: .ResourceType}' || echo "No resources" done

cd /workspace/cdk_app && npx cdk ls 2>/dev/null | grep EC2 | while read stack; do region=$(echo "$stack" | grep -oE '(us-east-1|us-west-1|us-west-2|eu-west-1|ap-southeast-1)$') echo "=== $stack (Region: $region) ===" # Get instance details aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --filters "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" 2>/dev/null | jq '.Reservations[].Instances[] | {instanceId: .InstanceId, vpcId: .VpcId, subnetId: .SubnetId}' done

for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== VPCs in $region ===" aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq '.Vpcs[] | {vpcId: .VpcId, cidr: .CidrBlock, isDefault: .IsDefault}' done

for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== Running instances in $region ===" aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --filters "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" 2>/dev/null | jq '.Reservations[].Instances[] | {instanceId: .InstanceId, vpcId: .VpcId}' | sort -u done

cat > /tmp/vpc_analysis.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # Collect all VPCs and instances by region declare -A vpc_has_instances for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "Processing region: $region" # Get all VPCs aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Vpcs[] | .VpcId' | while read vpc; do vpc_has_instances["${region}_${vpc}"]="false" done # Get running instances and mark their VPCs as having instances aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --filters "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Reservations[].Instances[] | .VpcId' | sort -u | while read vpc; do vpc_has_instances["${region}_${vpc}"]="true" done done # Now check and report echo "" echo "=== VPCs with NO instances ===" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "" echo "Region: $region" aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Vpcs[] | .VpcId' | while read vpc; do # Count instances in this VPC count=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" 2>/dev/null | jq '.Reservations[].Instances | length' | paste -sd+ | bc) if [ "$count" -eq 0 ] 2>/dev/null || [ -z "$count" ]; then echo " $vpc (no running instances)" fi done done EOF chmod +x /tmp/vpc_analysis.sh /tmp/vpc_analysis.sh

cat > /tmp/vpc_final.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash echo "=== VPCs with NO running instances ===" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "" echo "Region: $region" # Get all VPCs and check instance count for each aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Vpcs[] | "\(.VpcId) \(.IsDefault)"' | while read vpc is_default; do # Count running instances in this VPC count=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" 2>/dev/null | jq '[.Reservations[].Instances[] | .InstanceId] | length') if [ "$count" = "0" ]; then default_label="" if [ "$is_default" = "true" ]; then default_label=" (default VPC)" fi echo " $vpc$default_label - 0 running instances" fi done done EOF chmod +x /tmp/vpc_final.sh /tmp/vpc_final.sh

cat > /tmp/vpc_verify.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash echo "=== Complete VPC and Instance Inventory ===" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "" echo "=== Region: $region ===" # Get all VPCs aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Vpcs[] | .VpcId' | while read vpc; do # Get VPC details vpc_info=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" --vpc-ids "$vpc" 2>/dev/null | jq '.Vpcs[0] | "\(.VpcId) (\(.CidrBlock)) [Default: \(.IsDefault)]"') # Count running instances in this VPC running_count=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" 2>/dev/null | jq '[.Reservations[].Instances[] | .InstanceId] | length') # Get instance IDs instance_list=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Reservations[].Instances[] | .InstanceId' | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//') echo "VPC: $vpc_info" echo " Running instances: $running_count" if [ -n "$instance_list" ]; then echo " Instance IDs: $instance_list" fi echo "" done done EOF chmod +x /tmp/vpc_verify.sh /tmp/vpc_verify.sh

cat > /tmp/vpc_names.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash echo "=== VPCs with NO running instances - Final Report ===" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Vpcs[] | select(.IsDefault == false)' | jq -r '.VpcId' | while read vpc; do running_count=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" 2>/dev/null | jq '[.Reservations[].Instances[] | .InstanceId] | length') if [ "$running_count" = "0" ]; then vpc_name=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" --vpc-ids "$vpc" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Vpcs[0].Tags[]? | select(.Key=="Name") | .Value // "N/A"' | head -1) if [ -z "$vpc_name" ] || [ "$vpc_name" = "null" ]; then vpc_name="(no Name tag)" fi echo "$region: $vpc - $vpc_name" fi done done # Also check default VPCs echo "" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.Vpcs[] | select(.IsDefault == true)' | jq -r '.VpcId' | while read vpc; do running_count=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" 2>/dev/null | jq '[.Reservations[].Instances[] | .InstanceId] | length') if [ "$running_count" = "0" ]; then echo "$region: $vpc (default VPC)" fi done done EOF chmod +x /tmp/vpc_names.sh /tmp/vpc_names.sh
